summary.intent: Execute Wave 1 of phase 24 bug fixes and test infrastructure improvements across three parallel plans (24-01, 24-02, 24-03), then run regression gate and verify phase completion.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans completed successfully with 9 commits, 466+ passing unit tests across core/crypto/sdk-core/sdk packages, 5/5 must-haves verified, and phase 24 marked complete in roadmap.

repo: Bin IPNS 404 errors are auto-repaired via a publishWithVerify helper in loadBin — the pattern is repair-on-read rather than fail-fast.
Device registry uses a v1/v2 schema versioning strategy with lenient v1 reads during migration, not a hard cutover.
ipHash was previously stored as an empty string; SHA-256 is now the correct implementation in useAuth.ts and device-registry.service.ts.
Export file recovery mode was dead code (322 lines removed in 24-03), suggesting prior cleanup passes may have left stubs.
Integration tests that hit a live API are expected to fail with ECONNREFUSED in local dev — these are excluded from the regression gate.

code.finding: publishWithVerify helper added; loadBin now auto-repairs on IPNS 404 rather than propagating the error.
v1->v2 migration logic lives here alongside validateV2Registry and validateDeviceEntryBase validators.
DeviceRegistryVersion is a union type ('v1' | 'v2'), not an enum.
ipHash computation changed from empty string to SHA-256.
New registries are created as v2; existing v1 registries are read leniently.

workflow: Three plans were executed in parallel as a 'wave' then merged before running the regression gate — wave-then-gate sequencing.
Regression gate checks prior-phase test files explicitly, not just the current phase's new tests.
Phase completion requires a VERIFICATION.md with must-haves checked, a SUMMARY.md, and a roadmap/state commit — all three are gated steps.
pnpm exec is needed to run tests within individual packages in this monorepo (plain pnpm test did not work).

friction: Integration tests fail with ECONNREFUSED when the API server isn't running locally — requires manual exclusion from the regression gate each time.

Extracting prior-phase test file references required multiple bash commands and retries (find prior phase verification files → extract references → extract all paths) before a working approach was found.
open_items: Playwright E2E test added in 24-03 seeds a real vault via SDK — unclear if it runs in CI or only locally.
IPNS 401 interceptor with auto token refresh (24-02) added to client pool — token refresh edge cases under contention not explicitly validated in the transcript.
METADATA_SCHEMAS.md updated with v1/v2 version history — may need further updates if v3 migration is planned.
